test_scope: AST-only extraction of the actual helper and nested check. HTTPConnection/socket/Timer are fakes; real threading.Lock/Event allocate no thread. No full fixture import, socket, child, DB or browser. A first-run stdout/stderr log in the recovery directory may be retained without rerun.
source_checks: Only the exact oversized POST uses the same-connection helper; all other checks retain their transport and expected statuses.

Canonical loopback origin, exact 1048577-byte body, one HTTPConnection, explicit POST/path/Origin/Content-Type/Content-Length; only BrokenPipeError/ConnectionResetError are retained before attempting an actual response. No request replay or synthetic status.

One five-second absolute watchdog interrupts the captured original socket through header/body work. Connection establishment has remaining-budget timeout; every blocking operation checks the shared deadline. Timer cancellation/join is bounded to one second and unsettled/expired observation cannot pass.
Response body is bounded to one MiB, canonical single Content-Length is checked and actual consumed bytes/remaining length must complete. A truncated fixed-length response remains failure.
Both response and connection cleanup are attempted, primary transport exception remains primary, and any cleanup failure prevents a successful result.
Closed named method/path/request size/expected status metadata precedes each call. Failed transport keeps observed status null unless actually parsed, and records class without arbitrary error text.
